blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY — Five female green sea turtles were accidentally caught in fish corrals and were rescued, tagged, and released into Casiguran Bay in Aurora Province after local fisherfolk reported the incidents to environmental authorities, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) said on Monday. The turtles were found along the coasts of Barangays Dibet, Ditinagyan and Calabgan, prompting the DENR’s Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in Casiguran, the municipal environment office and the Philippine Coast Guard to conduct rescue operations.
